directDepositInfo: Send USDC.e directly to your wallet's Funder Address on Polygon. No bridge fee.
minimumDeposit: Polymarket requires a minimum deposit of {amount}. Deposits below this amount may not be credited to your account.
note: The deposit address is {bridgeAddress} generated by Polymarket. You can send {supportedCrypto}, and funds will be automatically bridged to Polygon and converted to USDC.e. If you want to send USDC.e directly on Polygon (e.g., using our withdrawal feature), you can send funds directly to the Funder Address without using the deposit address.
